title: YARN 状态机：Application 与 Container 的状态转移
expected_output:
Application state machine:
NEW -> NEW_SAVING -> SUBMITTED -> ACCEPTED -> RUNNING -> FINISHED
Container state machine:
NEW -> LOCALIZING -> LOCALIZED -> RUNNING -> COMPLETED
illegal transition example: RUNNING -> NEW is rejected by RM state machine
code:
app_fsm = ["NEW","NEW_SAVING","SUBMITTED","ACCEPTED","RUNNING","FINISHED"]
container_fsm = ["NEW","LOCALIZING","LOCALIZED","RUNNING","COMPLETED"]
print("Application state machine:")
print(" -> ".join(app_fsm))
print("Container state machine:")
print(" -> ".join(container_fsm))
print("illegal transition example: RUNNING -> NEW is rejected by RM state machine")
